h1: FLL Airport Car Service | Onyx Executive Miami
a1: Private black-SUV transfers to and from Fort Lauderdale-Hollywood International Airport (FLL). Flight tracking, meet-and-greet, fixed quote confirmed before you land.
l7: Where at FLL do you meet arriving passengers?
l8: Curbside at arrivals by default, or a meet-and-greet point past baggage claim if you'd rather not manage bags to the curb alone — confirmed with you when you book.
l9: How does Onyx handle a delayed or early FLL landing?
l10: Your chauffeur tracks the flight in real time and adjusts the pickup window automatically, at no change to the fixed quote you were given at booking.
l11: Do you cover Port Everglades cruise transfers from FLL?
l12: Yes. FLL-to-Port Everglades is a short, well-established run for us given how close the airport sits to the port, timed against your ship's boarding window.
l13: Is FLL usually faster than MIA for South Florida arrivals?
l14: For the Aventura/Sunny Isles corridor, yes in most cases — FLL tends to run 25–35 minutes versus MIA's 25–40, and FLL generally sees less airport-access congestion. Fort Lauderdale and Boca Raton destinations naturally favor FLL further still.
l15: Can I book a standing weekly or seasonal FLL pickup?
l16: Yes. Recurring FLL pickups for seasonal residents or frequent business travelers are arranged the same way as a one-off transfer, with the same chauffeur held for the standing schedule where possible.

h9: Your chauffeur tracks the flight and adjusts to early or delayed arrivals, then meets you curbside or at a pre-arranged meet-and-greet point inside the terminal — confirmed at booking, by your specific terminal (FLL runs Terminals 1 through 4, each with its own curb). A reasonable buffer for customs delays is factored into the pickup plan — ask us to confirm current wait-time terms when you book.
h10: To Aventura, Sunny Isles, Las Olas & South Florida
h11: FLL to the Aventura/Sunny Isles corridor typically runs 25-35 minutes outside peak hours — this is close to our home base, so timing and routing are well established, not a guess based on a map app. FLL to Las Olas and downtown Fort Lauderdale is closer still, typically 10-15 minutes.
h13: Every FLL transfer is quoted at a fixed price before the trip, tolls and standard wait time included. No surge pricing, no reassigned driver mid-trip.
h15: Continuing on a cruise from Fort Lauderdale? FLL sits minutes from Port Everglades, and we handle cruise-sized luggage as a matter of course. Flying in the day before your sailing rather than same-day removes the single biggest source of missed-boarding risk — worth considering for any cruise with a fixed departure time. We also cover MIA and DJT transfers →, plus PortMiami cruise pickups.
